note: draws[[1]] is the Blarge draw made once at the start; the rest are the B draws made at each bisection step, in order. R 0.2.2 standardises the large draws row-wise when it sets c_bd (CIhybrid.R line 80); Bei's code does it column-wise. Results may also differ slightly because R's L-BFGS-B differs from SciPy's; optim_calls shows R's path.
